title: Harka Abaaramaa
intro: Daandiiwwan marsaa Makkaa durii, bakka yeroo tokko lubbuun dhiibbaa fi qabeenya qabdu waamicha dhugaa irraa garagalte keessa dhaabbatta. Seenaan nama kanaa hidhata dhiigaa sansalata of tuulummaa mo’uu akka hin dandeenye yaadachiisa cimaadha. Inni maqaan isaa ibidda eeggachaa jiruun sagalee dhageessisu kun eenyu?
clues: Ergamaan dhiiga koo ta’us, of tuuluun dhugaa na jaamsee daandii Makkaa irra deeme.
Qabeenyi koo bal’aa ta’us, gaachana osoo hin taane abaarsa ta’e.
Kitaabni qajeelfamaa waa’ee badiisa koo dubbata, harki koo fi namni koo akka badu labsa.
Haati manaa koo duula diinummaa kootti makamtee, qoree walitti qabdee karaa nama gara Rabbiitti waame irratti babal’atte.
Guyyaa firdii ibidda abiddaa boba’aa keessa nan cuuphama, haati manaa koos funyoo fiber meexxii morma ishee ni qabatti.
Maqaa hiikni isaa ‘abbaa abiddaa’ — maqaa bakka jireenyaa koo isa bara baraa raajii ta’een beekama.

trial.label: Yaali ykn Taatee Ijoo
options: Nabiyyicha mormee Qur'aana keessatti abaaramaa ture
Dhagaa darbachuun Nabiyyii ajjeesuuf yaalii godhe
trial.answer: Nabiyyicha mormee Qur'aana keessatti abaaramaa ture

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Ibidda boba’aa keessa ni seena, qabeenyi isaas isa hin fayyadu
Erga ofirraa deebisee booda dhiifama argateera
outcome.answer: Ibidda boba’aa keessa ni seena, qabeenyi isaas isa hin fayyadu

arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
verse: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained. (111:2)
